articles.title: GHSA: Wings: Maliciously or erroneously created parsed config files can cause wings process to OOM
articles.summary:
### Summary
Config file parsers, `json`, `yaml`, `xml` etc in parser.go have no file size limit/checks, allowing for a giant config file to potentially OOM the wings process.

### Impact
All wings users who have an egg with a non-`file` parser configuration file setting.

articles.title: GHSA: OliveTin: Unauthenticated DoS via OAuth2 State Memory Exhaustion (Unbounded Map Growth)
articles.summary:
## Summary

OliveTin's OAuth2 login handler stores per-login state in an in-memory map (`registeredStates`) that grows unboundedly. States are added on every `/oauth/login` request but are **never deleted or expired**. s390/pkey: Check length in pkey_pckmo handler implementation

Explicitly check the length of the target buffer in the pkey_pckmo
